final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT p.product_color AS color, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Invoice_Line_Items i JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id GROUP BY p.product_color), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.color AS color, s1.cnt AS cnt, (s1.cnt * 1.0) / s2.total AS share FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.total IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM s3), s5 AS (SELECT s3.color AS color, s3.cnt AS cnt, s3.share AS share, s3.cnt - s4.avg_cnt AS diff FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.cnt > s4.avg_cnt) SELECT AVG(cnt), AVG(share), AVG(diff) FROM s5
